def set_max_open_files():
    try:
        setrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, (hard, hard))
    except ValueError:
        try:
            setrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, (65536, 65536))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Failed to set a high limit: {e}")
